title: Phủ Cam Cathedral
geometryBasis: The parish history gives the nominal length, width, north entrance and twin towers. Modern mapped approach and the hilltop tie locate the historical envelope approximately at the same site.
sectionBasis: The Dieulefils postcard shows symmetrical bell towers with low domes, stepped moldings and pinnacles, the entrance arcade, a gabled center with an oculus and the wide approach stair. Published church history describes 25 m towers.
limitations: The model depicts the demolished 1902 cathedral in the early Allys period. Its 1963 replacement has a different structure.
The exact historical foundation position, covered aisle spacing, external color, stair grade, roof transitions and apse are estimated.
